title: Inside the Mind of a Tech Investor with Gavin Baker
description:
An interview with Gavin Baker, Managing Partner and CIO, Atreides Management, LP, at Sohn Investment Conference 2026. The discussion covers his investment philosophy, his perspective on the current AI landscape, and future technological shifts. Moderated by Jas Khaira
Head, Blackstone N1.
summary: The speaker argues that the 'neo cloud' category is durable, highlighting CoreWeave, Crusoe, Nebius, and Lambda as high-quality operators with underappreciated business models and superior GPU utilization. He maintains a bullish stance on major semiconductor and infrastructure players like Nvidia, Google, Broadcom, and Amazon, citing specific strengths such as Nvidia's potential capacity scaling and Amazon's unique network architecture. Conversely, he expresses a bearish view on Blackstone, suggesting terrestrial data center operators face significant trouble if orbital compute gains market share.

claims.claim: The speaker loves Crusoe, believes it is going to work, and states they have a large position in Crusoe.

claims.quote: And by the way, this all goes for Crusoe and Nebius and other other high-quality neo clouds. But I think this is very under appreciated. And people think, "Oh, that can't be a durable competitive advantage."
